nodes.n: The envelope sits on the table for two days. Neither of you mentions it.

msgs.t: A London studio offered me a film. My first one that my mother didn't pick.
Shoot starts next month. Fourteen months.
It's the part I've wanted my whole life.

nodes.th: Fourteen months. Clause twelve. London. The math is very simple.

choice.t: "Take it. I'll fly in between series."
Tear up the divorce papers. Send her a photo.
choice.d: Answer one question at a time.

nodes.n: Mumbai. Her last day on a film her mother chose. A fake temple, fake rain, a director shouting about real tears.

nodes.t: I signed it. The divorce. This morning. Before the shoot.
Not because I want it. Because you saved your career with me, and I want you to stay with me because you want to. Not because of a contract.
So now there's no contract. Your turn. Sign it, or don't.

nodes.cliff: She signed first. The second signature box is waiting for you.

nodes.n: She doesn't know you already tore your copy. Nikhil has another copy. Nikhil always has another copy.
